text: Definitional (judgemental) equality vs. propositional equality: the key difference is:
choices: Definitional equality is undecidable; propositional is decidable
Definitional equality is checked by the type-checker; propositional equality requires a proof term
They are the same in HoTT
explanation: Definitional: checked automatically by normalisation (no proof needed). Propositional: requires explicit proof term p : a=b.
